'''Squad Seventeen''' was a division of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Begeren]], the squad was pinned down by [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] and [[cacophanizer shell]]s.
